title: 2026 UK GHG conversion factors fuel direct and WTT QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: The 2026 fuel-factor calculation had no methodological update from the previous release.
Direct fuel factors are based on factors used in the UK greenhouse gas inventory for 2024.
CO2 fuel factors assume full oxidation and combustion and are essentially application-independent.
facts.expected_handling: Do not add application-specific CO2 adjustments without source.

facts.source_fact: Natural gas, coal, petrol and diesel CO2 factors were updated to align with the latest UK GHGI.
CH4 and N2O factors can vary for the same fuel by use such as rail, shipping, NRMM or stationary combustion.
The 2026 CH4 and N2O fuel factors use activity-weighted averages from the 2024 GHGI.
Most GHGI factors start on a net-energy t/TJ basis and are converted to energy, volume and mass units using calorific values.
The fuel tables are separated into gaseous, liquid and solid fuels.
Natural-gas kWh supplied in the UK is generally on a gross-calorific-value basis unless the supplier states otherwise.
Fuel lifecycle or WTT emissions cover upstream extraction, transport, refining, conversion and distribution and are classed as Scope 3.
